| Path | Project | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `supabase-js-2.118.0.min.js` | [@supabase/supabase-js](https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js) 2.118.0 (UMD build) | MIT |
| `fontawesome-6.7.2/` | [Font Awesome Free](https://fontawesome.com/license/free) 6.7.2 (CSS + woff2 only) | Icons CC BY 4.0, fonts SIL OFL 1.1, code MIT |
| `fonts/space-grotesk-*`, `fonts/manrope-*` | Space Grotesk, Manrope via [Fontsource](https://fontsource.org) variable packages 5.3.0 (latin + latin-ext) | SIL OFL 1.1 |

Files are served with a one-year `immutable` cache (see `vercel.json`); never edit one in place — add a new versioned path instead.
